desc:
🏃 Jump, climb, and conquer exciting parkour stages to discover every hidden Slime!

🟢 There are 168 Slimes waiting to be found across the map. Can you complete the entire collection?

🌟 Test your parkour skills, explore every corner, and challenge your friends to see who can find them all first!

🎯 Every Slime is hidden in a unique location, so keep your eyes open and don't miss a single one!

💚 Leave a Like if you enjoyed the adventure!
⭐ Favorite the game so you can continue your collection anytime!
🔔 Follow for future Slime updates, new parkour stages, and more collectibles!
